_comment: Typo corrections applied to post titles and body text on import. These are genuine errors in the published Medium copy; everything else is left verbatim. Kept here rather than hand-edited into content/blog/*.md so a rerun of the importer can't silently reintroduce them. `find` is matched literally, not as a regex.

fixes.why: missing space — 'Prizes Announced for AI Innovation Grand Challenge'
misspelling — Q&A with Dr. Letetia Addison
surname not capitalised; appears in two posts and in one title

fixes.find: By using natural language, an application or agent can interpret and relay requests to anyone, not just to platform participants.
fixes.replace: By using NLIP, an application or agent can interpret and relay requests to anyone, not just to proprietary platform participants.
fixes.why: author-requested copy update to the NLIP post (081226 website edits) — clarifies it is NLIP (not natural language alone) that enables interoperability, and that the participants being locked out are proprietary ones. Kept here so a re-import from Medium does not revert it.

fixes.find: the governance of NLIP is through standards and not via a corporation or consortia with vested interests. Updates, licenses and rights are governed by the standard and not by the ever-changing needs of shareholders.
fixes.replace: the governance of NLIP is through standards, and not via a corporation or consortia with vested interests. Updates, licenses and rights are governed by the standard, and not by the ever-changing needs of shareholders.
fixes.why: author-requested copy update to the NLIP post (081226 website edits) — adds the serial commas before 'and not'. Kept here so a re-import from Medium does not revert it.
